STOMP UNDER FOOT Halo Bender Distortion (3 customer reviews) $168.00 $84.00 The Halo Bender is a versatile distortion pedal created out of my desire for a classic rock, guitar tone.The gain control goes from a low-gain Fender crunch all the way up to JTM45 distortion all while retaining the clarity of your guitar.The tone control Add to cart SKU: CCE78371391 Category: Pedals and FX Description Additional information Reviews Introduction The Halo Bender is a versatile distortion pedal created out of my desire for a classic rock, guitar tone. The gain control goes from a low-gain Fender crunch all the way up to JTM45 distortion all while retaining the clarity of your guitar. The tone control goes from a full, chunky low-end to a pleasing high-end all while retaining a punchy rumble on the lower strings and a smoothness on the higher strings. The tone control also works great when adjusting for single-coil or humbucking pick-ups. The Halo Bender covers everything from AC/DC, “You Shook Me All Night Long” tones to the Foo Fighters, “Learn To Fly” and everything in between.
